question: What constitutes the worship indicated in this ritual context?
premises: Worship is described as being performed.
A group of mantras is involved in the sacrifice.
By this alone the worship here is indicated.
inference: The indicated worship here consists in worship through that mantra-group alone.
uncertainties: The precise antecedent of anenaiva is not explicit in this unit.
plain_english: It is worshipped, thus: by this mantra-group of the sacrifice alone, worship is indicated here.
